findings.title: The power module's snapshot offset moves with the three new helm values, and the spec does not say so
findings.claim: §8 places thrCut, gas and gasIdle at helmAt + 3..5, but snapshot.ts computes powerAt = helmAt + 3 (its comment says the helm module holds three values). That must become helmAt + 6, and everything after it shifts. The spec names only the new reads.
findings.evidence: spec L300-L303; src/renderer/src/sim/duel/snapshot.ts:L151 (`powerAt = helmAt + 3`, comment 'the helm module holds three values'), L183
findings.why: The snapshot tests would catch it, but the plan's snapshot task should list it so it is not under-scoped.
findings.fix: Add to §8: `powerAt` becomes `helmAt + 6`, and update the L151 comment.

findings.title: NO GAS replaces the first hint line, but the new hint layout moves Q/E GAS to the second
findings.claim: §3.3 shows NO GAS in place of the first hint line. §6.1 moves `Q/E GAS` to the second line (`Q/E GAS  LMB STEER`). So the refusal appears beside the throttle hint, not where the gas key is named. The second line's control set ('turn', 'heading', 'auto-face') also loses its crew-Helm 'heading' and 'auto-face' refusals (§4) and is not restated.
findings.evidence: spec L176-L178 (first hint line); spec L247-L248 (new hint lines); src/renderer/src/ui/duel/HelmStation.tsx:L117-L118 (hint(['throttle'], ...) and hint(['turn','heading','auto-face'], ...))
findings.why: It is buildable as written, but a reader may take it for a slip, and the console test's expected line is fixed by it.
findings.fix: Either show `gas` on the second line (hint(['turn','gas'], 'Q/E GAS  LMB STEER')) or say outright that the first line is deliberate. Also list each line's control set for the crew Helm.

findings.title: The predicted latch's 'until throttleHeld has been 0 on a sample' has no start point
findings.claim: §7 says the prediction ramps with held 0 'until the seat's own throttleHeld has been 0 on a sample', but not since when: since the cut was sent, or since the replica's thrCut was first seen set. While the replica lags, its thrCut can still read set after the player has released S and pressed W again. Whether the prediction ramps W then depends on that start point.
findings.evidence: spec L290-L293; src/renderer/src/app/duel/onlineDuel.ts:L130, L216 (the sent-command records the prediction keys off)
findings.why: It affects a transient display only, not the authority, but two builds would show different throttle bars for one round trip.
findings.fix: Say 'a sample since the cut was sent (cutSent) or, with no cut in flight, since the replica's thrCut was first seen set'. Clear the record with cutSent.
